title: Fix Puzzle 5d 2d Preview Missing When Suggesting Parts From 2d
description: When adding a new suggested part in 2D in puzzle 5d, the preview shows in 3D but the new 2D node and edge are missing in 2D. Root cause: puzzle5dSyncBrushPreviewFromVolume calls flatRenderer.brushCancelSlot() when volume preview is null but flat session has sourceHandleId, racing with 2D-originated suggestions before volume sync completes.
summary: Fixed puzzle 5d 2d view after clicking a suggested part: only handle labels appeared because placement updated the unified model (3d correct) but never synced project2d(model) to flat WASM authoring peers. Added puzzle5dCommitBrushPlacementToPlay to apply unified placement, guard structural deletes, sync fixture descriptor to all peers, push authoritative scene, and finalize suggestions brush state. Registered this as puzzle2dSetBrushPlaceCommitHandler in Puzzle5dPlayHostBridgeInstaller; routed onBrushPlace through the same path. Exported puzzle2dFinalizeBrushSuggestionsPlacement and use it from both 2d and 5d commit paths.
